additionalEvaluation: Fresh isolated agents used copied source files and synthetic fixed responses. Local mock calls and returned responses are in the named JSONL traces; this does not verify a live connector.

The initial trace caught a content/source readback mismatch and reported partial verification. A fresh-context rerun with explicit synthetic content and source searched the exact key, created the candidate as Pending/Inferred, and read back matching key, scope, content, source, status, and confidence. No promotion occurred.
incompleteSteps: The synthetic scenario exposes no index operation, so index state was not tested.
